source: Production D1 (metric_events, realm N'Zoth, type world_buff_drop), newest 30 rows, read-only. Announcement texts are the real OctoWoW capital announcements.
note: No Alliance row exists after 02:37:08Z although an Alliance drop was reported at about 05:07Z; the Horde Rallying Cry at 05:06:21Z is stored.

payload.text: People of the Horde, citizens of Orgrimmar, come, gather round and celebrate a hero of the Horde. On this day, $n, under the auspices of our glorious Warchief, laid a mortal blow against the Black Dragonflight. The brood mother, Onyxia, has been slain!
Honor your heroes! On this day, they have dealt a great blow against one of our most hated enemies! The false Warchief, Rend Blackhand, has fallen!
Behold the might of the Alliance! The dread lady, Onyxia, hangs from the arches! Let the rallying cry of the dragon slayer lift your spirits!

NEFARIAN IS SLAIN! People of Orgrimmar, bow down before the might of $n and $g his:her; allies for they have laid a blow against the Black Dragonflight that is sure to stir the Aspects from their malaise! This defeat shall surely be felt by the father of the Black Flight: Deathwing reels in pain and anguish this day!
Citizens of the Alliance, the Lord of Blackrock is slain! Nefarian has been subdued by the combined might of $n and $g his:her; allies!
